name: flow
description: Five workflow commands for Claude Code: /flow:go (work discipline — verify before acting, fix root causes, consider security, run /code-review before reporting code changes done, never report false progress), /flow:cm (spec-compliant commits, one per unrelated change, with a secret scan before each), /flow:e2e (profile the project, plan, human review, generate Playwright specs, run and heal, report; everyday runs pick specs by a change-to-test table plus @critical), /flow:pin (reproduce one UI bug with a Playwright spec, then fix it and keep the spec as a regression test) and /flow:vet (a fresh-context subagent checks the commit message and new comments against the diff before committing; cm calls it automatically). The first four are manual-only.
